title: Walmart Marketplace Sellers: The Image Rules Costing You Placement (And How to Fix Them)
description: Walmart Marketplace has strict image rules that suppress non-compliant listings. Here's how to pass every time.

blocks.text: Walmart Marketplace is growing fast—and its image compliance rules are stricter than Amazon's. Sellers who ignore this get suppressed silently. No warning. No message. Just declining sales.
Here's how to stay compliant and rank.
Walmart's Image Requirements

items.text: Product fills at least 80% of frame
No watermarks, logos, or text overlays
No people or props (main image only)

blocks.text: Sound familiar? It should—Walmart's copying Amazon's playbook. But their enforcement is quieter, which makes it more dangerous.
The Compliance Workflow
Step 1: Audit every main image against Walmart's rules.

Step 3: Replace on Walmart Seller Center.
Step 4: Monitor Buy Box wins over the next 7-14 days.
Use Rights-Safe Source Images
Walmart is particularly strict on watermarks. Even faint supplier logos in the corner trigger suppression.

If a source image contains a watermark, obtain an unwatermarked file from the rights holder or create your own photo. edit-photo does not remove watermarks, and removing ownership marks without permission can create legal and marketplace risks.
The Additional Images
Walmart allows up to 8 additional images per listing. Most sellers use 2-3. Filling all 8 is a ranking signal.

The Buy Box Angle
Walmart's Buy Box algorithm considers image quality. Sellers with clean, compliant, complete image sets win more Buy Boxes than sellers with sparse or messy visuals.
If you're competing for Buy Box against another seller with identical price and shipping—image quality can be the deciding factor.
Amazon vs Walmart Photo Strategy
Good news: Amazon-compliant photos are almost always Walmart-compliant. Cross-list confidently.
Small differences:

items.text: Walmart allows slightly more lifestyle in secondary images
Walmart's zoom requirement is aggressive—need higher resolution
Walmart flags off-white more aggressively than Amazon does

blocks.text: If your photos work on Amazon, minor tweaks make them Walmart-perfect.
Cross-Platform Efficiency
Every product needs:

items.text: White background version (Amazon + Walmart + Google Shopping)
